accepted.reason: RiskModule.pokeConfig(address) (src/policy/risk-module/RiskModule.sol): the permissionless poke reads the Spoke's approval from the MarketRegistry, asks the drift logic (RiskModuleDriftLogic.spokeDrift) for a drift reason and records CONFIG_DRIFT on each Active or Offboarding market of the Spoke (bounded by the Spoke's markets, REQ-RISK-090). Every callee is fixed at deployment (the MarketRegistry proxy and the drift logic named by immutables); none is caller-supplied. The drift logic reads the Aave Spoke inside try/catch, so a failing Aave read reports drift instead of reverting the poke (REQ-CONFIG-076).

MarketRegistry.freezesInWindow(address) (src/policy/market-registry/MarketRegistryViews.sol): counts a guardian's address freezes in the hour buckets of the last day (REQ-MREG-019, at most MAX_ADDRESS_FREEZES_PER_DAY). block.timestamp is the specified clock of that rate limit; a validator's few seconds of timestamp drift moves a bucket boundary by those seconds and puts no funds at stake.

DebtOracle.borrowPriceMaxAge() (src/oracle/debt-oracle/DebtOracle.sol): the nested revert is the analysed contract's own dispatcher. The ParameterStore and MarketRegistry addresses are read from storage, which is symbolic on bare runtime code, so Mythril resolves them to the analysed contract. Every configuration and feed read is a gas-bounded staticcall whose failure is returned as ok = false (DebtOracleReads._call) and fails the evaluation closed (REQ-ORACLE-092); no revert of a callee is passed on.

DebtOracle.borrowPriceMaxAge() (src/oracle/debt-oracle/DebtOracle.sol, via _evaluate): block.timestamp is the specified clock of price freshness and grace (SPEC-ORC-015, REQ-ORACLE-043); a validator's few seconds of drift move a staleness deadline by those seconds against ages of minutes to hours, and put no funds at stake.

LPOracleCLViewLogic.getTokenPrices() (src/oracle/lp-oracle/LPOracleCLViewLogic.sol): the nested revert is the analysed contract's own dispatcher. The feed addresses are read from the feed proxy's storage, symbolic on bare runtime code, so Mythril resolves them to the analysed contract. Each feed read is a gas-guarded staticcall (LPOracleCalls.staticRead) whose revert is reported as ok = false and never passed on, and a failed read fails the evaluation closed (SPEC-ORC-023, REQ-ORACLE-001).
